agreements: Gearbox v1 verified baseline and Step009 Heartbeat verified foundation remain preserved; this review changes no formal state/code and claims no C PASS.
Heartbeat, poll, retry, reconnect, wait, scheduler wake, window age and uptime remain zero Experience.

Current v2.1 classification keeps DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND operational-only; they must not become verified Experience, P_base, Trust, Identity, Personality or Governance evidence.
Strict bool validation is useful type hardening, but it does not establish freshness, authority, evidence provenance or verifier authority.
verified_progress_density is currently reason-only; keeping it observational is acceptable until independently derived and adversarially validated.
The v2.1 contract correctly leaves speedup NOT_YET_STATISTICALLY_ESTABLISHED.

disagreements.finding: New material objection on current exact bytes: for a verified-class event with independently_verified=false, aggregate_experience_events computes delta=0 and enters the verified_kinds branch, but increments neither verified_experience nor ignored_events/rejected counters. The unverified verified-claim therefore disappears from ledger outcome statistics instead of becoming an explicit rejection/quarantine result. This can bias acceptance-rate, verification-quality and speed-baseline denominators and makes longitudinal audit unable to distinguish clean absence of claims from repeated failed verification claims.
disagreements.required_change: Make ledger outcomes exhaustive and auditable. Add explicit accepted_verified, accepted_operational, rejected_unverified_claim, ignored, duplicate, identity_conflict and malformed/quarantined outcomes or equivalent immutable receipt classes. A verified-class claim without trusted acceptance must be explicit zero-credit rejection/quarantine, not a silent statistical sink.

disagreements.finding: aggregate_experience_events parses independently_verified before EventKind classification, so verifier-irrelevant WAIT/HEARTBEAT/POLL/RETRY/SCHEDULER_WAKE/DURABLE_PROGRESS/ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND records with malformed verifier metadata can abort later valid evidence.
disagreements.required_change: Canonicalize/classify EventKind before verifier parsing; parse trusted verifier evidence only for verified classes; malformed irrelevant metadata must not abort later records or reserve identity.

disagreements.finding: secretary_signal_fresh remains caller-declared; literal true can label stale telemetry fresh because source, timestamp/TTL, revocation, scope, policy and runtime/install identity are unbound.
disagreements.required_change: Consume a replay-resistant SecretarySignalEnvelope with trusted source and freshness metadata.

disagreements.finding: authority_conflict=true only replaces secretary_level with UNKNOWN; it does not load or enforce the actual fresh authority decision, so permissive caller kwargs still determine routing.
disagreements.required_change: Project an exact trusted AuthorityDecisionEnvelope or fail closed.

disagreements.finding: recent_shift_rate_ratio is caller-supplied and thresholded at >=0.50 without canonical numerator/denominator, minimum sample, observation window, uncertainty or stateful enter/exit hysteresis; 1/1 can appear as 100 percent thrash.
disagreements.required_change: Derive shift rate from canonical append-only shift history with preregistered support/window/uncertainty and bounded hysteretic release; numeric thresholds remain TEST_REQUIRED.

disagreements.finding: Anti-thrash can reduce gear_shift_rate while delaying a safe necessary upshift and worsening cycle_completion_latency, verified_closure_per_hour or recovery_latency.
disagreements.required_change: Require paired performance non-regression and bounded release/cooldown; fewer shifts alone is not improvement.

disagreements.finding: verified_progress_density is currently reason-only, but because it is caller-supplied it would become self-reinforcing if later connected directly to routing authority.
disagreements.required_change: Keep observational until independently derived from a precommitted denominator/window and tested against self-reinforcement.

disagreements.finding: event_id dedupe exists only inside one aggregate invocation. Same evidence under new IDs and exact IDs across later calls/restart/rollback/poll can be re-credited; same-ID/different-binding is not durably detected.
disagreements.required_change: Use a durable rollback-resistant event/evidence-lineage acceptance registry with exact replay NO_OP, same-evidence/new-ID lineage duplicate and same-ID/different-binding IDENTITY_CONFLICT.

disagreements.finding: Verified Experience still depends on event kind plus booleans/stage labels; exact evidence hash and trusted C/independent-verifier identity/receipt are not mandatory in the executable path.
disagreements.required_change: Require immutable exact evidence identity plus trusted verifier acceptance receipt bound to mission/step/scope, freshness/revocation and installation/workspace identity.

disagreements.finding: select_gear_v2_1 recomputes verified and operational deltas directly from caller event fields instead of consuming an accepted ledger receipt.
disagreements.required_change: Every nonzero verified or operational credit must come from one immutable AcceptedExperienceReceipt; receipt-less decision calls emit zero credit.

disagreements.finding: v2/v2.1 can emit N or R but select_gear_v2 validates current_gear as G1..G6 only, so truthful next-cycle terminal state cannot round-trip without validation failure or state substitution.
disagreements.required_change: Define canonical current-control-state N/R/G1..G6 with explicit trusted terminal transition rules; anti-thrash/hysteresis must not parse N/R numerically.

disagreements.finding: GearboxV21Decision omits inherited v2 checkpoint_required, receiver_ack_required, verification_gate, real_experience_claim_allowed and pressure_score semantics.
disagreements.required_change: Re-project safety-critical inherited metadata or bind an exact inherited-v2 decision fingerprint/reference; v2.1 may tighten but never erase inherited safety constraints.

disagreements.finding: v2 gates real_experience_claim_allowed on C_VERIFIED, while v2.1 recomputes verified_experience_delta directly from caller event fields without consuming inherited stage eligibility.
disagreements.required_change: Every authoritative verified delta must originate from one immutable AcceptedExperienceReceipt binding exact evidence identity, trusted C/independent-verifier receipt and canonical verification stage.

disagreements.finding: Weights 5/4/3 for verified classes and 1 for operational classes are engineering heuristics, not calibrated capability units.
disagreements.required_change: Never interpret aggregate credit as capability truth, Trust, Identity, Personality, Governance evidence or promotion threshold.

disagreements.finding: No exact-current paired evaluation establishes speedup. Commit count, wake count, heartbeat count, window age or awake time are invalid substitutes.
disagreements.required_change: Use sealed matched workloads and paired/randomized crossover baselines over durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency with frozen numerator/denominator provenance, exposure/censoring/order, complete assigned-workload coverage, uncertainty and verification/risk non-regression.

statistical_risks: Verified-class claims that fail verification currently vanish into a zero-credit but non-rejected statistical sink, biasing acceptance-rate and quality denominators.
Malformed irrelevant verifier fields can create batch-order censoring, so later evidence disappears from the analyzed sample.
Caller-declared secretary freshness/authority and unbound pressure provenance invalidate causal routing comparisons.
Small-n caller-supplied shift-rate estimates can false-trigger anti-thrash or chatter around the threshold.
Anti-thrash may improve gear_shift_rate while degrading cycle, closure or recovery latency.
verified_progress_density becomes self-reinforcing if policy-created progress is later fed back into routing authority.
Transient event identity, same-evidence/new-ID replay and direct credit bypass can inflate longitudinal Experience/progress totals.
Cross-layer v2/v2.1 Experience semantics can count the same event differently and contaminate model-selection analysis.
5/4/3/1 credits are ordinal engineering heuristics, not capability units.
Speed metrics are numerator/denominator/exposure/order/coverage sensitive and require matched paired/crossover evaluation.
proposed_tests: GB21-UNVERIFIED-CLAIM-AUDIT-122: a verified-class event with independently_verified=false must produce an explicit rejected_unverified/quarantine outcome; it may not silently disappear from accepted/rejected/ignored accounting.

GB21-LEDGER-OUTCOME-CONSERVATION-123: for every input record, exactly one exhaustive ledger outcome class must be emitted or counted; accepted_verified + accepted_operational + rejected_unverified + duplicate + identity_conflict + ignored/malformed must reconcile to total records under the declared batch policy.
GB21-QUALITY-DENOMINATOR-124: repeated unverified verified-claims must lower or at least remain visible in verification-quality/acceptance metrics; they cannot be omitted from the denominator.
GB21-SHIFT-RATE-PROVENANCE + SHIFT-SMALL-N + ANTI-THRASH-CHATTER + RELEASE remain required.
Durable cross-run/restart/rollback replay, same-evidence/new-ID and same-ID/different-binding cases remain required.
Verified evidence without exact trusted verifier/C receipt must yield zero authoritative verified credit.
Terminal N/R roundtrip, terminal exit authority and inherited safety metadata projection remain required.

Paired speed baseline must use durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency under sealed matched workload and randomized/crossover order.

blocks: authoritative Experience accounting from current v2/v2.1 paths
automatic authority escalation based on secretary/anti-thrash/progress heuristics
speedup or capability claims from raw credit totals, commits, wakes or uptime

release_condition: Fresh exact-current v1+v2+v2.1 executable regression evidence is available on the same candidate bytes; historical results are not promoted as fresh PASS.
Secretary freshness and authority conflict are evidence-bound to trusted replay-resistant envelopes, with fresh authority decision actually projected.
recent_shift_rate_ratio is derived from canonical history with precommitted support/window/uncertainty and hysteretic release; anti-thrash passes performance non-regression.
verified_progress_density remains observational unless independently derived and proven non-self-reinforcing.
Experience/event accounting uses durable rollback-resistant identity/lineage acceptance and exhaustive auditable outcome classes; unverified verified-claims cannot disappear from statistics.

Every authoritative verified Experience credit is bound to exact evidence and trusted C/independent-verifier receipt; every nonzero verified/operational delta comes from an immutable accepted receipt rather than raw caller fields.
DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND remain operational-only across all authoritative v2/v2.1 interfaces.
Terminal N/R state semantics round-trip safely and inherited v2 safety metadata is preserved by v2.1.
Credit weights remain heuristic-only and are not used as capability/Trust/Identity/Personality/Governance truth.

Speedup is established only by a precommitted sealed matched paired/randomized-crossover baseline using durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency with complete assigned-workload coverage and verification/risk non-regression.
Dedicated W03 adversarial review and fresh Navigator synthesis have zero unresolved material vetoes before any formal A->B->C routing is considered.
